author: Lena Ortiz
text: The 2025 SOC 2 Type II report runs through 31 December 2025. I cannot find a 2026 bridge letter in the repository.

author: Jonah Reed
text: Confirmed: no current bridge letter was attached to the vendor portal export either.

author: Priya Nair
text: The USD 8,400 service-credit calculation reconciles to the outage log, but it is still pending Northstar acceptance.

author: Martin Shaw
text: I sent the price scenario model. Target 3%; 7% is ceiling, not a concession we volunteer.

author: Lena Ortiz
text: Annual audit and 24-hour incident notice remain must-haves. Fifteen-day subprocessor notice is too short; policy requires 30 days.

author: Ava Chen
text: AI use clause is still open. Do not paste my privileged fallback language into vendor-facing notes.

author: Martin Shaw
text: No follow-up session is on the calendar yet. We should leave the call with owners and dated next steps.

author: Jonah Reed
text: Dependency is high: Northstar feeds three customer dashboards. A rushed lapse would disrupt reporting, but we can send non-renewal notice without stopping service immediately.
